evaluation_scope.body_completeness: Successful fetch means extracted text is available; previews, truncated pages, and incomplete extraction may be present.
evaluation_scope.body_labels: 22 fetched bodies reviewed; other body relevance is null/unjudged, not negative. Body details are partial target examples, not exhaustive coverage.
evaluation_scope.comparison: Use one fixed document pool for BM25-only, embedding-only, and hybrid comparisons; unjudged query-document pairs must not be treated as negatives. This artifact does not run those comparisons.
evaluation_scope.directional_strength: No numeric evidence-strength or future-price targets have been invented.
evaluation_scope.duplicate_labels: same_core_claim applies to the specified headline or body detail only; it does not mean whole documents are interchangeable or independently corroborated. Event groups are provisional topic/event metadata, not duplicate ground truth.
evaluation_scope.headline_detail_scope: Headline spans are partial source-claim examples and may contain compound claims; only body details have explicit offsets.
evaluation_scope.headline_labels: Apply only to headline snapshots, not fetched article bodies.
evaluation_scope.historical_headlines: All selected headline snapshots were collected after their query cutoffs. Provider observation time is not proof that this exact title was available at that cutoff.
evaluation_scope.labels: Assistant draft annotations for review; not human-verified ground truth and not verification of publisher claims.
evaluation_scope.recall: No recall claim outside the judged pool.
evaluation_scope.selection: Curated sample; not representative of the full news pool.
evaluation_scope.splits: No training or test split is implied.

label_rubric.offsets: Python Unicode character offsets, start inclusive/end exclusive, into exact saved body.

relevance.0: Unrelated to the specific target event/actor, including misleading lexical overlap.
relevance.1: Contextual: related topic but no direct evidence on the target claim.
relevance.2: Direct: reported facts, expectations, plans, or statements bearing on the target claim; does not imply truth or sufficient resolution.
relevance.null: Unjudged or uncertain; never treat as zero.

label_rubric.review_status: draft_assistant requires user review before treating labels as ground truth.
